description: Runs the Brandrail Checker on UI code you wrote (TSX/JSX, Angular components and templates, Vue, Svelte, HTML, CSS, PHP, Twig, Mustache/Handlebars). Returns a brand score and each violation with the fix. Call once after writing UI with every file you changed in `files`, and fix every error and warning before finishing.

code.description: A single file or snippet (when not using files)

filename.description: File name for code; the extension decides how it's parsed

files.description: Every file you changed, checked together as one result. Preferred over code/filename.

project.description: Repo or app name, e.g. customer-portal (shown in the dashboard)

name: validate_snippet
title: Validate UI code against the design system
